rows.text: We established a presence in the Socialist Republic of Vietnam in 1999 and later constructed there the largest solar PV farm in Southeast Asia in 2019.
rows.source_sentence: We established a presence in the Socialist Republic of Vietnam in 1999 and later constructed there the largest solar PV farm in Southeast Asia in 2019.

rows.text: In 2021, we achieved a new milestone– the world’s largest hydro-floating solar hybrid project at Sirindhorn Dam, as EPC member under a collaboration of B.Grimm Power and Energy China.
rows.source_sentence: In 2021, we achieved a new milestone– the world’s largest hydro-floating solar hybrid project at Sirindhorn Dam, as EPC member under a collaboration of B.Grimm Power and Energy China.

rows.text: Our commitment for innovation extends beyond Thailand, with a significant presence in the Republic of Korea, boasting a growing portfolio of operational solar and wind farms.
rows.source_sentence: Our commitment for innovation extends beyond Thailand, with a significant presence in the Republic of Korea, boasting a growing portfolio of operational solar and wind farms.

rows.text: We have recently secured a participation –in development of the Nakwol 1 & 2 offshore wind farms in the Republic of Korea, totalling a capacity of 740 MW – the largest wind project to be developed by the private sector in the Republic of Korea.
rows.source_sentence: We have recently secured a participation –in development of the Nakwol 1 & 2 offshore wind farms in the Republic of Korea, totalling a capacity of 740 MW – the largest wind project to be developed by the private sector in the Republic of Korea.

rows.text: Our dedication expands further with the development of a significant portfolio of solar farms totalling 250-300 MW in the Italian Republic.
rows.source_sentence: Our dedication expands further with the development of a significant portfolio of solar farms totalling 250-300 MW in the Italian Republic.

rows.text: While the 35 MW solar power rooftop project - the largest single solar PV rooftop project in Thailand - signifies a strong development in rooftop solar solutions, securing the rights to develop the monumental Nakwol 1 & 2 offshore wind farms in the Republic of Korea marks a true milestone in our journey towards clean energy leadership.
rows.source_sentence: While the 35 MW solar power rooftop project - the largest single solar PV rooftop project in Thailand - signifies a strong development in rooftop solar solutions, securing the rights to develop the monumental Nakwol 1 & 2 offshore wind farms in the Republic of Korea marks a true milestone in our journey towards clean energy leadership.

rows.text: Additionally, our recent acquisition of Amatera Renewable Energy Corporation to develop the 65 MW solar power plant in the Republic of the Philippines and our renewable expansion in Japan further solidify our commitment to clean energy.
rows.source_sentence: Additionally, our recent acquisition of Amatera Renewable Energy Corporation to develop the 65 MW solar power plant in the Republic of the Philippines and our renewable expansion in Japan further solidify our commitment to clean energy.

rows.text: These endeavours, along with our ongoing projects across the globe, position B.Grimm Power as a frontrunner in the transition to a clean energy future.

rows.text: We prioritise a strong financial structure and reduction of carbon emissions by following the International Energy Agency’s 2C Non-OECD Pathway to Net Zero Carbon Emissions by 2050.
rows.source_sentence: We prioritise a strong financial structure and reduction of carbon emissions by following the International Energy Agency’s 2C Non-OECD Pathway to Net Zero Carbon Emissions by 2050.

rows.text: We are developing tiered renewable energy tariffs, using solar- rooftop plants to produce green energy and firming it with our state-of-the-art combined cycle co-generation power plants, batteries, integration of electric vehicles, and advanced digital tools including distributed energy resource management systems.
rows.source_sentence: We are developing tiered renewable energy tariffs, using solar- rooftop plants to produce green energy and firming it with our state-of-the-art combined cycle co-generation power plants, batteries, integration of electric vehicles, and advanced digital tools including distributed energy resource management systems.

rows.text: We will further assist customers with carbon offset certificates and energy efficiency services to be their prime enabler on their journey to Net Zero.
rows.source_sentence: We will further assist customers with carbon offset certificates and energy efficiency services to be their prime enabler on their journey to Net Zero.

rows.text: The “Flexible Power” initiative targets Thailand and Vietnam, with the goal of optimising the efficiency of our combined cycle co-generation power plants, reducing ramp times to balance renewables, and preparing for a future in which these plants primarily balance the grid.
rows.source_sentence: The “Flexible Power” initiative targets Thailand and Vietnam, with the goal of optimising the efficiency of our combined cycle co-generation power plants, reducing ramp times to balance renewables, and preparing for a future in which these plants primarily balance the grid.

rows.text: With the “Renewable Power” initiative, we aim to play a significant role in the global energy transition and to take advantage of the tremendous growth in the renewable energy sector.
rows.source_sentence: With the “Renewable Power” initiative, we aim to play a significant role in the global energy transition and to take advantage of the tremendous growth in the renewable energy sector.

rows.text: Our focus is on economies in the region and beyond, which enhance our investment grade and offer appealing and abundant opportunities through rapid growth and transition to renewable energies.
rows.source_sentence: Our focus is on economies in the region and beyond, which enhance our investment grade and offer appealing and abundant opportunities through rapid growth and transition to renewable energies.

rows.text: In 2019, B.Grimm Power announced a commercial operation of the largest solar farm project 420 MW in ASEAN, as well as the investment in a hydro power plants in Lao PDR, an electrical transmission and distribution business, a solar project in the Kingdom of Cambodia, a joint collaboration for the development of a hybrid power plant (combined cycle co-generation power plant and a solar farm with the energy storage system or ESS) in the U-Tapao Airport and Eastern Aviation City project, and investment initiatives in renewable energy in several countries such as Malaysia, Japan, Republic of Korea, the Italian Republic and Republic of the Philippines.
rows.source_sentence: In 2019, B.Grimm Power announced a commercial operation of the largest solar farm project 420 MW in ASEAN, as well as the investment in a hydro power plants in Lao PDR, an electrical transmission and distribution business, a solar project in the Kingdom of Cambodia, a joint collaboration for the development of a hybrid power plant (combined cycle co-generation power plant and a solar farm with the energy storage system or ESS) in the U-Tapao Airport and Eastern Aviation City project, and investment initiatives in renewable energy in several countries such as Malaysia, Japan, Republic of Korea, the Italian Republic and Republic of the Philippines.
